description: FULL BODY: A Malaysian male in his late 30s, athletic build, wearing a dark navy blue PDRM (Royal Malaysia Police) uniform with silver insignia on the shoulders and a formal peak cap. He wears polished black boots and stands with a professional, authoritative posture.

FULL BODY: An elderly Malaysian man in his late 60s, silver hair, wearing a traditional beige Baju Melayu with a simple sarong and leather sandals. He has a concerned expression and a lean, slightly hunched frame.

FULL BODY: An anonymous featureless humanoid figure standing in a dark void. The figure is a solid matte-black silhouette with glowing blue digital circuitry patterns pulsing across its chest and limbs, representing artificial intelligence.

FULL BODY: A featureless human silhouette that appears unstable, with horizontal digital glitch lines and static interference covering its entire form. The figure has a flickering white and grey noise texture, suggesting a synthetic imitation of a person.
